name: Onee-chan Tasukete! ~Shoujo ga Ochiru Made~
original_name: お姉ちゃん助けて！～少女が堕ちるまで～
source:
Europe, 5th century A.D. Melvin family invades Burgundia and captures Helena royal princesses. Her sister Theodora struggles as a military commander, but is defeated. Melvin commander Julian is fascinated by Theodora's nobility and courage. Eventually it transforms into desire to corrupt her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
